note: Generated by scripts/tests-first.mjs --update: do not edit. The replay of one commit.

failedFirst: a picture is kept as a new file in the folder beside the note, and a second of the name takes the next
an SVG is refused whatever it is named, and nothing is kept; the kind is read from the first bytes
a picture kept is shown from the bytes read back, and a name never given is not found
a file in the folder that is no picture is not sent as one
a request that is not a picture is refused: not JSON, no bytes, base64 that is not plain, none for a note not open
a host that cannot read a picture back keeps none, and says so
board_images_kept: the page keeps a picture by the server > a picture dropped is sent with its name and bytes in base64, the token in a header, and its link is taken back
board_images_kept: the page keeps a picture by the server > a refusal of the server is said in words, and one too large is refused before anything is sent
board_images_kept: the page keeps a picture by the server > a picture is shown from the bytes the server sends, asked for once, never from an address of the page’s own making
board_images_kept: the page keeps a picture by the server > a link to anything but a picture kept beside this note is not asked for: the web, another folder, another ending
board_images_kept: the page keeps a picture by the server > a picture the server does not have shows as none, and so does a call that fails
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > a PNG is kept in the folder beside the note, as the same bytes, and its link is given from the vault top
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > a name taken gives the next number, and the picture already there is never changed
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > the kind is read from the first bytes, not the name: a JPEG named .svg is kept as a .jpg
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > an SVG, a page and bytes that are no picture are refused whatever they are named, and nothing is written
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > a request that is not a picture sent whole is refused: not JSON, no bytes, base64 that is not plain
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > one larger than eight million bytes is refused, and nothing is written
board_images_kept: a picture is kept beside the note > it takes the page’s token and its own origin, as any change does
board_images_kept: a picture never leaves the vault, and never goes through a link > a folder beside the note that is a link out of the vault is refused, and nothing is written outside
board_images_kept: a picture never leaves the vault, and never goes through a link > a file in the folder that is a link is never written through: the picture takes the next name
board_images_kept: a picture never leaves the vault, and never goes through a link > a note whose folder is reached by a link out of the vault is never opened, so no picture is kept there
board_images_kept: a picture is sent back with its own type > the bytes come back as they were kept, as their own type, with no sniffing and nothing it may run
board_images_kept: a picture is sent back with its own type > it asks for the token, and sends no picture to the proposer’s key
board_images_kept: a picture is sent back with its own type > a name the server could not have given is not found: a path, a hidden file, an SVG, a link, a file that is no picture
a picture is known by its first bytes alone > a PNG, a JPEG, a GIF of either year and a WebP are each known, and nothing else is
the name a picture is kept under > is a plain stem of safe marks with one of four endings, never a path or a hidden name
the name a picture is kept under > is kept in a folder named attachments, at most eight million bytes, sent in a request a third larger
a picture is read back as base64, which a message carries as text
a path that climbs out, is hidden, or goes through a link is refused before the disk is asked
a file larger than a picture may be is not read as one, and a file not there is ENOENT
